rule.quote: 每一個預告句用回收它的那一章的畫面（同一張圖）

code_readback.guard_is_read_only: Use readCache(workdir), existsSync and hash actual bytes; never use cached() as a readonly guard because it can mutate/delete cache.

pairs.narration_setup_text: 一張價牌，為什麼會讓上市前的準備突然改動？
pairs.narration_payoff_text: 回到準備中的價牌，企業史說，服部正次當晚到場，看過後要求改回四十五萬。
pairs.no_result_drawn_in_teaser: Anonymous neutral object before final placement/inspection; no readable price, measured furnace value, changed result or historical named likeness.

input_tuple.prompt: Close-up at a shop preparation counter, an anonymous worker holding a small unmarked price card beside a plain gold-colored wristwatch, gentle light from the left.. Style: cute Taiwanese YouTube explainer cartoon: chibi characters with big round heads, large expressive eyes and exaggerated comic expressions, thick clean dark outlines, flat colours with soft cel shading, a limited palette of deep navy night, parchment yellow, muted teal and one warning-red accent, subtle paper grain, simple clear backgrounds, one subject in the centre third, playful and friendly, 16:9. Camera: pan left

pairs.narration_setup_text: 而工廠的一座真空爐，又藏著什麼沒被記下的事？
pairs.narration_payoff_text: 回顧認為更大的問題，是設定溫度沒有作為資料記錄下來。
pairs.no_result_drawn_in_teaser: Anonymous neutral object before final placement/inspection; no readable price, measured furnace value, changed result or historical named likeness.

input_tuple.prompt: Medium shot at a factory heating station, an anonymous supervisor examining an unmarked control knob beside a closed vacuum furnace and a closed plain folder, mild overhead light.. preconditions: Current independent source/visual and fresh native reviews, exact owner gates, real new-project US$25 accounting and protected admission, and complete all-in quote are pending.
Before paid work, read actual provider/model/version/size/negative/refs/seed/fixes/prompt limit and recompute native keys; declared example values are not live backend/cache evidence.

MANDATORY READONLY LIVE CACHE GUARD BEFORE SECOND COMMAND
checks: Read official keyframes/manifest.json payoff selected item: judge passed, needs_review false, exact seed/take/fixes/live-key and selected file.
Hash actual selected file bytes and match selected.sha256.
Use readCache(workdir), require entries[live-key], matching provider/model/file existence and actual bytes SHA equal entry.sha256.
Cache miss, file missing, SHA mismatch, changed request, retake or selected crop mismatch: STOP pair. Do not run teaser to buy another image.

actual_verification_required: Both scenes independently pass the ordinary judge.
Read actual official manifest selected file references and selected SHA for both, then hash the actual final bytes.
After any trim/crop require the same final selected derived file and SHA; original generated SHA alone is insufficient.
Assembly input must use the same actual selected image in teaser and payoff. Preserve normal cache/job/ledger receipts.
production_handoff.on_failure: Stop; no force/accept-best, lookalike paid reroll, fake alias, custom manifest or hand-edit cache.
